Title: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) now supports node image autoupgrade in public preview

Body.Content:
We are announcing the public preview of AKS node image auto upgrade feature. With this feature, you will be able to opt-in so your node image is auto-upgraded when a new AKS node image becomes available.

Learn more.
